game.title: Max Payne 3
game.blurb: Third-person shooter from Rockstar Games, released 2012-05-15. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story, Part by Part
chapters.summary: Finishing Part I, Part II and Part III of the story.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the story on Medium, Hard, Hardcore and Old School.

chapters.title: Level Feats and Grinds
chapters.summary: One-off feats inside story levels: the zipline, the VIP window, the chain, the push cart, the bus ride, the runway, the rickety boat and more, plus finishing every single-player grind.

chapters.title: Clues, Golden Guns and Tourist Spots
chapters.summary: Finding every clue, every golden gun and every tourist location.

chapters.title: New York Minute
chapters.summary: The New York Minute mode, including its Hardcore version.

chapters.title: Combat Skills
chapters.summary: Painkillers, headshots, Bullet Time, Shootdodge, melee, grenades and using every weapon.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Ranking up, Gang Wars, Deathmatch, wagers, unlocks and playing with friends.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Map and Mode Packs
chapters.summary: Feats tied to extra multiplayer maps and modes, such as the Departure Lounge, Imperial Palace, Hoboken Bar, Panama Canal, Dead Men Walking and Challenge Mode.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4280); RAWG keeps "Max Payne 3: The Complete Edition" and "Max Payne 3: Painful Memories Pack" separately. The only Steam store match is app 204100; its schema has an empty game name. None of the 67 Steam achievements are hidden. 21 achievements have API names starting DLC2, DLC4, DLC5, DL6 or DLC6, so they come from added multiplayer content; the pack names are not in the data, so the chapter is named after the maps and modes the descriptions mention, and DLC2 to DLC6 are only API numbers. Two API names start SPMP (melee kills and Shootdodge kills), which may count in both single player and multiplayer; they sit in Combat Skills. The level feats name places and moments (the VIP window, the boardroom, the runway) but not which Part they belong to, so they have their own chapter rather than being guessed into Parts. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs): Gameplay, Table of Contents and Walkthrough are linked, but no subpages exist. maxpayne.fandom.com answers the API with about 66 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
